reviewMethod: All ten actual production viewport screenshots opened individually with view_image; every stored image hash rechecked. No edited or composite images used.

reviewed.label: options-economy
reviewed.observation: The actual compiled app Options menu displays Économie, selected publicly. No clock or frame-cadence injection is involved.

reviewed.label: stairs-lower
reviewed.observation: The three members stand below the four shallow steps, with visible contact-shadow meshes and feet near their supporting surface.

reviewed.label: stairs-middle
reviewed.observation: The leader is on the approach steps while the two followers occupy lower positions; feet and shadows move with each member’s support.

reviewed.label: stairs-upper
reviewed.observation: The N7 leader stands on the raised council landing; the actual upper export z=-19.4639 confirms the climb. The followers remain staggered on the approach.

reviewed.label: stairs-returned
reviewed.observation: The leader has descended to the lower approach, actual export z=-15.1277. Followers occupy higher steps; their contact shadows remain at their own ground.

reviewed.label: pillar-before
reviewed.observation: The leader is completely hidden behind the nearest opaque column, with the two followers exposed on its left. The capture label refers to sequence order.

reviewed.label: pillar-behind
reviewed.observation: The leader is visible to the right of that column, while another member remains masked. No sprite fragments show through its solid face.

reviewed.label: pillar-emerged
reviewed.observation: The column hides most of the group while thin visible body portions appear at its edges. This is ordinary local depth occlusion, not a whole-character visibility toggle.

reviewed.label: camera-threshold-stop
reviewed.observation: The actual exported x19.5882 crosses the x18.75 clamp. The architecture and party are settled after the public key release.

reviewed.label: camera-threshold-stationary
reviewed.observation: The architecture framing matches the stopped view; the public export position is identical. Ordinary actor motion/ambient changes do not indicate camera oscillation.

scope: Compiled HTTP app: public Citadel stair ascent/descent, opaque-column sprite occlusion and positive camera clamp. Native tests independently cover support/feet/shadow coordinates and both threshold signs.
limitations: Economy quality chosen via public Options; no hardware FPS, original floor-plan fidelity, Electron or Windows claim.
Prepared Citadel chapter save is declared; preceding victories and traversal are not browser-earned.
No retreat/re-engagement boundary claim. QA-fuite-et-reentree remains Prototype and partial.
